help.title: How to play
help.move: Move left/right. Bounce automatically. Wrap at edges.
help.monsters: Stomp monsters to bounce. Avoid their sides.
help.pickups: Shields block one hit. Jetpacks give a short boost.
help.platforms: Green: safe. Blue: moving. Red: breaks. Yellow: boost.
help.stars: Collect stars. They stay saved and unlock skins.
help.endless: Climb into harder zones. A fall ends the run.
help.close: Click, tap or press a key to close

tutorial.heading: {step}/{total} · {title}
tutorial.move.title: Steer your bounce
tutorial.move.body.keyboard:
Hold A / D or Left / Right to steer.

Land on a platform to bounce again.
tutorial.move.body.gamepad:
Move the left stick or D-pad to steer.

Land on a platform to bounce again.
tutorial.move.body.touch:
Hold the left or right side of the screen to steer.

Land on a platform to bounce again.
tutorial.pickup.title: Collect a boost
tutorial.pickup.body.keyboard:
Move into a shield or jetpack.

Shields protect you; jetpacks carry you upward.
tutorial.pickup.body.gamepad:
Steer into a shield or jetpack.

Shields protect you; jetpacks carry you upward.
tutorial.pickup.body.touch:
Steer into a shield or jetpack.

Shields protect you; jetpacks carry you upward.
tutorial.hazard.title: Stay above monsters
tutorial.hazard.body.keyboard:
Land on a monster from above to defeat it.

Avoid touching its sides.
tutorial.hazard.body.gamepad:
Land on a monster from above to defeat it.

Avoid touching its sides.
tutorial.hazard.body.touch:
Land on a monster from above to defeat it.

Avoid touching its sides.
tutorial.pause.title: Take a breather
tutorial.pause.body.keyboard:
Press Escape or use Pause when you need a break.

Resume when you are ready.
tutorial.pause.body.gamepad:
Press Start or use Pause when you need a break.

Resume when you are ready.
tutorial.pause.body.touch:
Tap Pause when you need a break.

Resume when you are ready.
tutorial.waiting.title: Keep climbing
tutorial.waiting.body:
Reach the top by bouncing between platforms.

The next tip appears when you need it.
tutorial.skip.hint: Dismiss all tips and keep playing
